This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).

This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner, Shashidhar Barik, with a prayer for direction to the opp. parties to take necessary action regarding consideration of the representation under Annexure-5, which is dated 19.12.2024 and re-estimate the quantum of the compensation amount as per the Govt. bench Mark Valuation and nearest vicinity area.

sentences.text: On instruction, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that such application has not been filed and seeks permission to withdraw this writ petition in order to file an application under section 64 of the 2013 Act.
In view of such submissions, the writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn.
